formulaProofs.name: ZeroFreePlot.gaussian_correct
formulaProofs.statement:
∀ (L : ℝ),
  1 ≤ ZetaNearOneBudgetLimit.scale (Real.exp L) →
    Formula.real L gaussian = ZetaGaussianRegionUnion.width (Real.exp L)

formulaProofs.name: ZeroFreePlot.reserve_correct
formulaProofs.statement: ∀ (L : ℝ), Formula.real L reserve = zetaPoleReserveZeroMargin (Real.exp L)

formulaProofs.name: ZeroFreePlot.unified_correct
formulaProofs.statement: ∀ (L : ℝ), Formula.real L unified = ZetaUnifiedZeroFree.width (Real.exp L)

formulaProofs.name: ZeroFreePlot.classical_correct
formulaProofs.statement: ∀ (n d : ℕ) (L : ℝ), Formula.real L (classical n d) = ZetaGaussianBandFrontier.classicalWidth (↑n / ↑d) L

formulaProofs.name: ZeroFreePlot.littlewood_correct
formulaProofs.statement: ∀ (n d : ℕ) (L : ℝ), Formula.real L (littlewood n d) = ZetaGaussianBandFrontier.littlewoodWidth (↑n / ↑d) L

formulaProofs.name: ZeroFreePlot.vk_correct
formulaProofs.statement: ∀ (n d : ℕ) (L : ℝ), Formula.real L (vk n d) = ZetaGaussianBandFrontier.vkWidth (↑n / ↑d) L

formulaProofs.name: ZeroFreePlot.allHeight_nonvanishing
formulaProofs.statement: ∀ (s : ℂ), s ≠ 1 → 1 - ZetaUnifiedZeroFree.width s.im ≤ s.re → riemannZeta s ≠ 0

formulaProofs.name: ZeroFreePlot.crossoverGap_correct
formulaProofs.statement: ∀ (L : ℝ), Formula.real L crossoverGap = ZetaGaussianBandFrontier.crossoverGap L

formulaProofs.name: ZeroFreePlot.plotted_comparison
formulaProofs.statement:
∀ (s : ℂ) {L : ℝ},
  ZetaGaussianBandFrontier.crossover < L →
    L ≤ Formula.real L ceiling →
      |s.im| = Real.exp L →
        1 - ZetaUnifiedZeroFree.width s.im ≤ s.re →
          riemannZeta s ≠ 0 ∧ ZetaGaussianBandFrontier.benchmarkWidth L < ZetaUnifiedZeroFree.width s.im

formulaProofs.name: ZeroFreePlot.headlineEnvelope_correct
formulaProofs.statement:
∀ (L : ℝ),
  max (Formula.real L (classical 24297 5000))
      (max (Formula.real L (littlewood 981 50)) (Formula.real L (vk 2567 50))) =
    ZetaGaussianBandFrontier.benchmarkWidth L

formulaProofs.name: RiemannGaussian.ZetaGaussianExpandedComparison.nonvanishing_and_comparison
formulaProofs.statement:
∀ (s : ℂ) {L : ℝ},
  ZetaGaussianBandFrontier.crossover < L →
    L ≤ 480000 →
      |s.im| = Real.exp L →
        1 - ZetaUnifiedZeroFree.width s.im ≤ s.re →
          riemannZeta s ≠ 0 ∧ ZetaGaussianBandFrontier.benchmarkWidth L < ZetaUnifiedZeroFree.width s.im

scope: Selected explicit benchmark families, not an exhaustive world-record comparison. External analytic proofs are not imported into the Lean union.

comparisonTheorem.name: RiemannGaussian.ZetaGaussianExpandedComparison.nonvanishing_and_comparison
comparisonTheorem.statement:
∀ (s : ℂ) {L : ℝ},
  RiemannGaussian.ZetaGaussianBandFrontier.crossover < L →
    L ≤ 480000 →
      |s.im| = Real.exp L →
        1 - RiemannGaussian.ZetaUnifiedZeroFree.width s.im ≤ s.re →
          riemannZeta s ≠ 0 ∧
            RiemannGaussian.ZetaGaussianBandFrontier.benchmarkWidth L <
              RiemannGaussian.ZetaUnifiedZeroFree.width s.im
